name: has_phd
description: Founder holds a PhD or doctorate.
expression: lambda founder: any('phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: prior_ipo
description: Founder has been involved in a prior IPO.

name: industry_tech_or_bio
description: Industry is Technology, Information & Internet Platforms or Biotechnology & Nanotechnology Research.
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in ['technology, information & internet platforms', 'biotechnology & nanotechnology research']

name: has_mba_or_msc
description: Founder has a master's degree in relevant fields.
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('degree', '').lower() in ['mba', 'ms', 'master'] for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_experience_in_high_tech
description: Founder has work experience in high-tech industries.
expression: lambda founder: any('software' in job.get('industry', '').lower() or 'it' in job.get('industry', '').lower() or 'technology' in job.get('industry', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_includes_health
description: Industry involves healthcare or medical equipment.
expression: lambda founder: 'health' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: exit_event
description: Founder has an IPO or acquisition event.

name: education_qs_below_50
description: Founder has education with QS rank below 50.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) < 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_known
description: Founder industry is known and not NaN.
expression: lambda founder: bool(founder.get('industry')) and founder.get('industry') is not None

name: has_experience_in_leadership_roles
description: Founder has held leadership roles (e.g., CEO, President).
expression: lambda founder: any(role.lower() in ['ceo', 'president', 'founder', 'principal'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []) for role in [job.get('role', '')])

name: has_extensive_experience
description: Founder has more than 9 years of experience in roles or durations.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_duration(job.get('duration', '')) > 9 for job in founder.get('jobs', [])) or any(parse_duration(e.get('duration', '')) > 9 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: company_size_industry_match
description: Company size aligns with industry typical scale.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) >= 50 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_international_experience
description: Founder has worked in roles with international or large company experience.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_company_size(job.get('company_size', '')) >= 1000 for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: education_in_top_qs
description: Founder has education from top QS-ranked institutions (rank 1-50).
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_experience_relevant
description: Founder has worked in industries relevant to their startup's focus.
expression: lambda founder: any(job.get('industry', '').lower() in ['software development', 'healthcare', 'biotech', 'it services'] for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_multiple_roles_experience
description: Founder has held multiple different roles across their career.
expression: lambda founder: len(set(job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))) > 2
